purpose: Track the original game's systems and content against implemented behavior and independent evidence. This is an expandable inventory, not an exhaustive specification or a completion percentage.

reference.anchorRule: Timeline line numbers refer to src/original/MainTimeline.as. Embedded-class anchors identify the original SWF class and its method; export files are ignored, reproducible derivatives.

identityPolicy: Keep ledger IDs stable. Preserve original numeric content IDs during migration. Future additional content should use separate namespace-qualified IDs and explicit save migrations, never reuse an original ID or infer identity from display text.
evidencePolicy: Source inspection, port unit tests, browser observations and original-versus-port comparisons are different evidence. Passing tests or extracting an asset does not mark its entire feature complete. Update status only from a concrete implementation or observation.

intentionalDifferences: Current JSON format accepts only browser-port saves; it is not Flash SharedObject-compatible.
Version 1 browser saves lacked generated item metadata. Reconstructed metadata has explicit provenance; original Flash save conversion remains missing.

Legacy trait and boss-kill information is reconstructed/inferred with explicit provenance; missing hero stats receive explicitly marked deterministic replacement values in v6. Battle RNG is preserved, while previously omitted result rewards consume normal RNG once.

Versions 1–3 paid settlement before reward selection. Version 4 reverses that advance for pending rewards, pays once at results and preserves the final balance; completed old results receive missing result/AP draws once.
Old enemy saves without shadow history keep their former frame-derived behavior; subsequent transitions persist the flag.
Version 5 retains inactive item metadata because original generation can reuse it. Metadata previously discarded by older browser versions cannot be recovered.
The complete prepared town, including searched and its RNG draw after the original autosave point, is persisted together to prevent partial initialization on restore.
Cumulative earned money is reconstructed for older saves from already implemented settlement; purchases do not decrement this historical earnings counter.
